desc: A person walking on a hard floor - corridor, warehouse, stairwell, street.
prompt: a single person walking at a steady pace on a bare concrete floor, hard leather soles striking stone, a sharp click on each heel strike with a short slap from the toe, close microphone, dry, no reverb
negative: music, speech, rhythm, drums, reverb, echo, crowd
note: PARTIAL: same limit as footsteps_grass - no sync to picture, no control of step rate. Cut single steps out for anything on-camera. Generated DRY on purpose: put the corridor or stairwell on it afterwards with reverb, so this one bed serves every hard-floor space instead of needing a render per room.

evidence.method: audio_sweep: rendered + measured (ffmpeg ebur128/silencedetect, librosa flatness)
evidence.note: renders and is not broken [seconds=6.04, lufs=-11.4, true_peak=3.3, silent_fraction=0.0, channels=2]
